node_definition.done_when: Done when. Tests with a temporary repository and crew home show the following: An advice hold leaves no reservation on disk. crew resume --advice during the hold is accepted. A reservation naming a dead pid, and one naming a host whose lease has expired, are both released on read. One naming a host whose lease is fresh is kept. A resume mark whose attempt has a result record does not hold review dispatch. A coordinator resume with advice, sent while an automatic repair round holds its reservation without a worker, launches the coordinator's advice and records the repair round superseded. Every resume, automatic or coordinator, writes one transition row a follower prints. Negative control: the advice-hold case against the base revision refuses the resume, and the failing run is logged.
node_definition.goal: a reservation or lock holds only while its holder is working on it
node_definition.negative_control: the section's done-when names its negative control: the same test run against the base revision fails, and the failing run is logged
